title: Iron Ingot Meets Ziwei
description: Iron Ingot from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled about something...

mainQuestExcel.title: Iron Ingot Meets Ziwei
mainQuestExcel.description: Iron Ingot from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled about something...

dialogs.text: The Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies. It's so beautiful...
Are you star gazing?
Yes... and no. It's the Lantern Rite, after all. It only seems fitting to look upon such an elegant sight during these festive times.
I've even been learning how to write poetry, too. The other guys tell me that girls these days are really into that sort of thing.
Hah, I'm sure Ziwei will...
Learning poetry?
Uh — ahem, well, I've heard a lot of constellation names from Ziwei. *sigh* They all sound so beautiful...
So you see, I have to thank her somehow!
I was thinking that I should write a poem on a Xiao Lantern and find a place to release it together with Ziwei... We'll eat snacks and sing songs...
If this doesn't get the job done, nothing will!
Get the job... done?
Ahem, I mean... This will do the job of helping us enjoy the festival more... Yeah, that's it!
Anyway, I want to find a quiet, scenic spot away from other pedestrians.
I started asking around and I've found two potential spots so far. Here, have a look.
The other guys told me that they've released Xiao Lanterns at these spots before...
But I still need to come up with a poem... and I'm afraid running around to check the spots will just douse my creativity.
Could you help me go check out those two spots?
Sure.
Thanks for your help, I'm counting on you!
Ziwei?

flow.stepDescription: Find the first suitable viewing spot and <color=#00E1FFFF>take a picture</color>

dialogs.text: Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies... What does it mean?

flow.stepDescription: Find a second suitable viewing spot and <color=#00E1FFFF>take a picture</color>

dialogs.text: Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies... What does it mean?
"Ziwei stumbles across an iron ingot" ...No, no, that won't do. That's laying it on a bit thick...
Oh, when did you get here? Did you check those two spots?
We sure did.
That didn't take you long. Now let me have a look...

Alright, let me have a look here... Hmm, the surrounding scenery at this spot is very unique, whereas the other spot is centered in a more picturesque landscape. It reminds me of the line, "Ain't no mountain high enough, ain't no..." Uh, I forget what's after that...
Anyway, never mind... Still, these spots look bright and impressive.
I've got it! I know which one to pick... But, there's still something I'd like to ask of you, Traveler.
My friends told me that when you go to see someone, it's best to bring something to eat. What do you think I should prepare when I go to see Ziwei?
Grilled Tiger Fish.
Grilled Tiger Fish, hmm... Don't you think that'd be a little too oily? Maybe something a little more light and refined, like Almond Tofu...
Yeah, Almond Tofu! That would be perfect!
Traveler, could you please help me prepare a serving of Almond Tofu? In the meantime, I'll keep working on my poem here. Now how should this next line go...
"And countless sparks fly"... Oh, that's a good line!
Almond Tofu.
Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies... What does it mean?

flow.stepDescription: Give the Almond Tofu to Iron Ingot

dialogs.text: Oh, when did you get back? Did you prepare the Almond Tofu?
Yep, it's ready.
I still need a little more time...
Ah, okay. Don't worry, I can keep working on my poem in the meantime...
Huh? Is it me... Or does this tofu smell funny?
I could never give this to Ziwei. Maybe you could help get another one?
Well, I guess this will do for now. Let's go find Ziwei!
This looks great! Everything's ready, all we need to do now is find Ziwei!

flow.stepDescription: Go with Iron Ingot to meet Ziwei

dialogs.text: From this angle... The constellation looks just like a dog. Now, I must think of a suitable name...
Oh, it's you, Iron Ingot. What are you doing here?
Umm, well you see... Uh, I—I was just strolling outside the city, and I happened to come across a very scenic spot...
A nice spot? You mean for star gazing?
Y—Yes, that's it! A nice spot for star gazing. It'd also be a great place to release Xiao Lanterns... See? I've already prepared one for us.
And look, I've even written a p—poem on it...
"Sparks fly where shovel and meteorite meet."
Yes... Well, even though I don't really know what your wish is, the poem is quite interesting.
But you shouldn't let others see your wish before releasing the Xiao Lantern, otherwise it will never come true.
And so, what exactly do you need from me?
Well, I...
He found a very suitable spot for releasing a Xiao Lantern.
Releasing a Xiao Lantern? Oh, I'm sorry... I was actually hoping to go somewhere away from all the lanterns.
The Xiao Lanterns are so bright that they obstruct my view of the stars. I think I'll be going as far as I can away from the festivities.
Thanks for the kind offer, but I should get going. Happy Lantern Rite.
O—Oh...
And there she goes...
I... I'm fine. Clearly, I must have made my poem too abstract. Ziwei didn't get it at all.
Don't worry, I won't let it get to me. She'll finally understand my meaning one day.
Thanks for your help anyway, Traveler. Here, these are for you.
Oh, I guess I should at least release this Xiao Lantern now...
Keep your chin up.
So if you'd like to release a lantern tonight, you can go together with him.
